concerns: The evidence does not establish frequency, nationwide breadth, or preference over alternatives; those usage claims should be softened.
result.rationale: For edible corn, Indonesian and Malaysian Malay both use jagung. The supplied recipes show food use in each locale, and the Malaysian [DBP dictionary entry](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=setahun+jagung) independently supports the edible sense. No evidence here supports a national difference or false-friend reading.
